answer.reason: In EIA's Massachusetts Electricity Profile, Table 1 (net generation by sector) shows that electric utilities account for only a small share of Massachusetts generation, since nearly all in-state generation comes from independent power producers/CHP facilities. Massachusetts' total net generation is roughly 20.4 million MWh, so the ~20.37 million figure corresponds to the total/IPP-level value, while the much smaller ~0.5 million MWh figure is the electric utilities' net generation.
